description: This file is a shell script used for testing git cherry functionality. It contains test descriptions, environment setup, and a series of shell commands to perform various git operations and assertions related to cherry-picking patches and detecting upstream changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, with a description and a set of shell commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp used in commits to ensure order.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files and checks if they are identical.
